purpose: Teach: 異色/利得/顔写真/開閉/管制/政局/ボーダー/県外

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、異色の研究分野にも飛び込め
lines.en: Ren, don't be afraid to jump into fields outside your comfort zone.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Light emphasis on 'don't be afraid'—not a command, an invitation. Calm certainty. The voice of someone who has seen what happens when young people play it safe.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。短期利得ではなく真理を求めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll chase the truth, not quick wins.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Slight hesitation before the second clause—he's committing to something he believes in, not just agreeing. Steady finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、IDカードの顔写真を提出しろ
lines.style: Businesslike, brief. No warmth, no coldness—just the factual task. Professional courtesy. The tone of someone handling necessary details.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験室扉の開閉履歴を管理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep the lab access logs organized.
lines.style: Quick, competent response. The tone of someone who understands the ask and has already begun doing it. No flourish, just capable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究データの管制プロセスを整理しろ
lines.en: Ren, streamline the data management process for your research.
lines.style: Practical instruction. Slight pause after the name—he's watching to see if Ren is listening. Delivered with quiet weight, like this matters more than the previous tasks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費は政局の影響を受けます
lines.en: Yes. I understand research funding is vulnerable to political shifts.
lines.style: Formal, measured. He's showing he understands the larger context, not just the immediate task. A note of soberness underneath—he's learning that systems are fragile.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、専攻のボーダーラインを越えて学べ
lines.en: Ren, learn beyond the boundaries of your major.
lines.style: Firm encouragement. The rhythm here is different—gentler than the administrative orders, more insistent. He's passing on something he believes matters for Ren's future.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。県外学会への参加も計画します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also plan to attend conferences outside the prefecture.
lines.style: Responsive, forward-looking. A small lift at the end—he's not just accepting the advice, he's already extending it. The voice of someone who has heard what matters.
